THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

What Happened

As you record, the four diary pages fill in. Keep what happened. Take out what the writer felt or thought.

FIRST DAYLAST DAY
THE SCENE

You are in the library after school, making a poster. Your class wrote diaries as sailors on Hōkūleʻa. Each diary page tells one part of the trip. The poster must tell only what happened, in order. Four people each have one page you need.

THE HISTORY

These diaries are about Hōkūleʻa, a sailing canoe from Hawaii. In 1976 it sailed all the way to Tahiti. With no maps, Mau Piailug found the way by the stars. Thousands of people were waiting for them in Tahiti.
